prompt: A corner ornament for a frame, TOP-LEFT orientation, arms running along the top and left edges: stamped tin corner bracket with rivets and a tiny star. Arms end cleanly at the canvas edges (touching the top and left edge is allowed for THIS asset), transparent elsewhere. Matches the palette and materials of the skin.

uso: Separador horizontal entre secciones.
prompt: A thin horizontal divider, perfectly symmetric left-right: a thin barbed-wire line with a tiny five-point star in the exact centre. Readable on both dark and light backgrounds.
